explanation: The theorem proves multiplicativity of the project-defined reduced norm for general ℍ[K, α, β]. Mathlib has `Quaternion.normSq.map_mul` (`Mathlib/Algebra/Quaternion.lean`), but it concerns only the standard quaternion algebra ℍ[K], not this general algebra and reduced norm. Searches for `nrd_mul` and `nrd` in Mathlib found no matching declaration.
